steps: Union: an ID seen in only one instance's rows passes through to the merged output.
Dedup: identical rows (deciding fields status/recipe/live_sha/evidence_path/account) collapse to one copy, counted in the report stats.
Conflict: rows that disagree exclude the ID from the merged output entirely; the conflict report lists the ID with both rows + the differing fields named.
An id-less row is a conflict, never merged.

disjoint_lenses() names any lens overlap; merge_files() writes merged rows + the JSON report {stats, conflicts, lens_overlap, activation_blocked}; CLI smoke: two fixture files with one contested ID merge to the single uncontested row, the conflict report lists the contested ID, activation_blocked reads False on disjoint lens sets (and an overlap logs NOT activatable).
